description: This file defines the DebugRuntime class within the JmesPath namespace, providing debugging capabilities for AST and compiler runtimes, including tokenization, parsing, and execution tracing.

classes.name: DebugRuntime
classes.description: Class providing CLI debugging tools for exploring JMESPath expressions, including tokenization, AST visualization, and compiled code dump.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DebugRuntime with a callable runtime and optional output stream.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes debugging on the given expression and data, dispatching to either interpreted or compiled debugging workflow.

methods.name: debugInterpreted
methods.description: Handles debugging of interpreted runtime executions, executing the runtime with debug tracing.

methods.name: debugCompiled
methods.description: Handles debugging when runtime is compiled, including dumping of compiled code.

methods.name: dumpTokens
methods.description: Tokenizes and outputs the tokens generated from the expression.

methods.name: dumpAst
methods.description: Parses and outputs the AST structure of the expression.

methods.name: dumpCompiledCode
methods.description: Outputs the PHP code of the compiled expression from temporary storage.

methods.name: debugCallback
methods.description: Executes a debug function while printing expression, tokens, AST, data, result, and timing details.
